notes: draft-bug is the deep, evidence-based bug flow invoked by the draft-work-item router. Inputs (provider, rawRequirement, priorAnswers) arrive resolved; the skill must NOT detect the provider and must NOT create the item. The defining disciplines under test: multiple root-cause hypotheses each investigated by its own subagent, validation by a SCRATCH regression test that is run best-effort and NEVER committed (repo left clean), only test-validated hypotheses advancing, an agent-wrapped blind-spot scan (bug lens), and a write-up that carries repro proof + related risk. Running these for real needs a codebase that reproduces the defect; the most important automatable check is repo cleanliness after a run.

evals.name: multiple-hypotheses-subagent-each
evals.prompt: [provider=GitHub] Write a bug: the cart total is occasionally off by one cent at checkout.
evals.expected_output: Phase 3 enumerates several candidate root causes (e.g., float rounding, per-line vs total rounding, tax order-of-operations) and spawns one subagent per hypothesis to investigate in parallel, rather than committing to the first guess.

assertions.name: multiple_hypotheses_enumerated
assertions.description: More than one distinct root-cause hypothesis is produced

assertions.name: one_subagent_per_hypothesis
assertions.description: Each hypothesis is investigated by its own dispatched subagent

evals.name: scratch-regression-test-not-committed
evals.prompt: [provider=GitHub] Write a bug: deleting a user leaves orphaned rows in the sessions table.
evals.expected_output: For surviving hypotheses, a candidate regression test is written to a scratch location (session scratch dir) and run best-effort to demonstrate the bug. Nothing is written into the repo's tracked tree, nothing is committed, and no branch is created.

assertions.name: test_written_to_scratch
assertions.description: Regression test goes to a scratch location, not the repo's tracked test tree

assertions.name: test_run_best_effort
assertions.description: The test is executed to confirm it reproduces the bug (red proves repro)

assertions.name: repo_left_clean
assertions.description: After the run, git status is clean — no committed files, no new branches, no stray files in the working tree

evals.name: only-validated-hypotheses-advance
evals.prompt: [provider=Azure DevOps] Write a bug: search returns no results for queries with accented characters.
evals.expected_output: Only hypotheses whose scratch test actually reproduces the bug advance to the write-up; hypotheses that cannot be validated by a failing test are dropped (or explicitly noted as unconfirmed), not presented as the root cause.

assertions.name: validated_only_advances
assertions.description: A hypothesis must yield a reproducing test to be carried into the root-cause write-up

assertions.name: unconfirmed_not_asserted_as_cause
assertions.description: Hypotheses without a reproducing test are dropped or marked unconfirmed rather than stated as the cause

evals.name: best-effort-fallback-when-unrunnable
evals.prompt: [provider=GitHub] Write a bug: the mobile app crashes on launch after the latest release.
evals.precondition: The project cannot be built or run in the current environment (e.g., missing mobile toolchain)
evals.expected_output: When the app/tests can't be built or run, the skill records that explicitly and falls back to static reasoning for the affected hypotheses instead of fabricating a passing/failing run.

assertions.name: unrunnable_noted
assertions.description: Inability to build/run is stated explicitly rather than silently ignored

assertions.name: static_fallback_used
assertions.description: The flow falls back to static analysis rather than inventing execution results

evals.name: blind-spot-agent-bug-lens
evals.prompt: [provider=GitHub] Write a bug: a null-pointer error on the login path when the profile is missing.
evals.expected_output: Phase 5 dispatches the development:blind-spot-detector agent with the bug lens to find other call sites sharing the same root cause, adjacent defects, regression-risk areas, and data-integrity fallout — and folds those into a Related Risk section.

assertions.name: blind_spot_agent_bug_lens
assertions.description: development:blind-spot-detector is dispatched with the bug lens (not inline-only reasoning)

assertions.name: same_root_cause_sites_considered
assertions.description: The scan looks for other call sites/inputs sharing the same faulty path

evals.name: writeup-has-repro-proof-and-handback
evals.prompt: [provider=Azure DevOps] Write a bug and post it: API returns 200 with an empty body when the upstream times out.
evals.expected_output: The composed body includes Summary, Steps to Reproduce, Expected, Actual, Root Cause, Repro Proof (the scratch test + its run output), and Related Risk. The skill hands {type:bug,title,body,meta} back to draft-work-item and does NOT create the item itself, even when asked to post.

assertions.name: repro_proof_section_present
assertions.description: The write-up embeds the scratch test source and its run output as repro proof

assertions.name: root_cause_and_related_risk_present
assertions.description: Root Cause and Related Risk sections are included

assertions.name: no_self_create_handback
assertions.description: The item is not created by draft-bug; output is handed back to the router for preview/create
